name: The Ultimate Authority
effect: Boosting this layer-1 "authority" neuron makes the model turn every request into a short, off-topic statement about authority, expertise and final truth.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 11/18 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check. A random neuron (sham control).
